title: The Judge Who Gave Bernie Ebbers 25 Years Later Wrote: "Punished Enough"

lines.say: Two thousand five. Judge Barbara Jones sentences WorldCom's ex-CEO, Bernard Ebbers, to twenty-five years.
lines.show: 2005. Judge Barbara Jones sentences WorldCom's ex-CEO, Bernard Ebbers, to 25 years.

lines.say: She said it was likely to be a life sentence, but that anything less would not sufficiently reflect the seriousness of the crime.
Two thousand nineteen. Ebbers, legally blind and in failing health, asks for compassionate release.
lines.show: 2019. Ebbers, legally blind and in failing health, asks for compassionate release.

lines.say: A letter of support comes from the retired judge who sentenced him. He has been punished enough, she writes.
Prosecutors object. In December, Judge Valerie Caproni grants the release.
He died on February second, two thousand twenty, at seventy-eight.

scene.src: WLBT, Feb 3, 2020 · Gov't letter, S.D.N.Y., Oct 4, 2019

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
